NOTICE
Notice is hereby given that pre-cancasing of the Absentee/Mail-in ballots will begin at 7:00 a.m. Tuesday, November 3, 2026, in the Elections Office Tabulation Room located in the Union County Government Center, 155 N. 15th Street, Lewisburg.
The Board of Elections will meet in the Elections Office Tabulation Room at 10:00 a.m. on Friday, November 6, 2026 to begin the official computation and canvassing of the votes cast from the November 3, 2026 General Election.
